business_problem: Guanjiapo Software had to support dealers and end users across many versions of its management-software portfolio, but the product complexity made it hard for bots to understand questions accurately. Multi-turn dialog required precise slot configuration, knowledge-base upkeep and FAQ curation were labor-intensive, service agents faced heavy workloads, and long waits plus rigid bot responses were hurting customer experience.
solution_summary: Guanjiapo Software integrated Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi Xiaomi Standard Edition service into its customer-service environment and deployed adaptation agents across all business units and subsidiaries. The implementation starts by connecting the service directly to the company's existing enterprise knowledge base so product manuals, support content, and operational know-how can be reused instead of being reauthored as static FAQ trees. Dealer and end-user questions are routed through the agent layer, where Tongyi Xiaomi handles intent understanding and multi-turn conversation before retrieving the relevant knowledge for a response. Guanjia Po also uses Tongyi Xiaomi's built-in operations tools to tune model behavior, improving context handling and recognition accuracy for complex service dialogs. The result is a shared conversational support stack that covers many product lines while giving service teams faster knowledge access and users a more natural self-service channel.

data_flow: Dealer and end-user questions from Guanjia Po's support systems enter business-unit-specific adaptation agents built on Tongyi Xiaomi. The agents pull from the connected enterprise knowledge base, use Tongyi Xiaomi's operational tuning to improve intent and context handling, and return conversational answers or agent-assist guidance to customers and service staff.
business_outcome: The Tongyi Xiaomi deployment gave Guanjia Po a more natural self-service experience and a more efficient support operation. The company reported smoother and more humanized conversations, stronger linkage to diverse knowledge, 30% higher customer-service team efficiency, and 30% of questions being handled intelligently and accurately, which improved user satisfaction and overall processing efficiency.
